subject: general
question: In a code language, 'HOTEL' is coded as 'DQPGH' and 'BANKS' is coded as 'XCJMO'. How will 'LOGIC' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/349d9345aa6566e72437f9f4bc00c4e55d34ec26ae0f9355a10b7dcb5695395a.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'HOTEL' is coded as 'DQPGH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fff0cccbb45560002cf4b92a9357ddefeaa0fc6f050369b741b7731197991b70.png] 

'BANKS' is coded as 'XCJMO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/229b3fb19635dd6227ae6ff412039bd366ba371fde0ed21ab1afec3743c6ee00.png] 

Similarly, for 'LOGIC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2b79c39ae6dde152ebdd8a3f1f7521208ff0e67ddacee2568668b4da663681c.png] 

So, 'LOGIC' will be coded as 'HQCKY'.

Hence,** 'Option 3'** is the correct answer.
